pages.text: A 3–7 block cube of Superheater Array Casings around an air core, with the Controller centered on the front face. Feed Steam, High-Pressure Steam, or Superheated Steam into its input tank and heat through a Thermal Conduit. A Wrench sets the facing or cycles Auto, High-Pressure, and Superheated modes. The array upgrades steam only when it has enough heat; otherwise it passes the input grade through.
